title: In the Germany 1. Bundesliga during the 2008/2009 season, find home teams t
question: In the Germany 1. Bundesliga during the 2008/2009 season, find home teams that won their matches and also had a 'Fast' build-up play speed class in any recorded team attribute entry. Return the team names ordered by their number of wins in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1.XCL_173, COUNT(M.XCL_006) AS win_count
FROM Team AS T1
INNER JOIN Match AS M ON T1.XCL_171 = M.XCL_013
INNER JOIN League AS L ON M.XCL_008 = L.XCL_003
WHERE L.XCL_005 = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
  AND M.XCL_015 > M.XCL_016
  AND T1.XCL_171 IN (
    SELECT TA.XCL_177
    FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
    WHERE TA.XCL_180 = 'Fast'
  )
GROUP BY T1.XCL_171, T1.XCL_173
ORDER BY win_count DESC

SELECT T1.XCL_173, COUNT(M.XCL_006) AS win_count
FROM Team AS T1
INNER JOIN Match AS M ON T1.XCL_171 = M.XCL_013
INNER JOIN League AS L ON M.XCL_008 = L.XCL_003
WHERE L.XCL_005 = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
  AND M.XCL_015 > M.XCL_016
  AND T1.XCL_171 IN (
    SELECT TA.XCL_177
    FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
    WHERE TA.XCL_180 = 'Fast'
  )
GROUP BY T1.XCL_171, T1.XCL_173
ORDER BY win_count DESC

    t.XCL_173 AS team_name,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_wins
FROM 
    Match m
JOIN 
    Team t ON m.XCL_013 = t.XCL_171
JOIN 
    League l ON m.XCL_007 = l.XCL_003
JOIN 
    Country c ON l.XCL_004 = c.XCL_001
JOIN 
    Team_Attributes ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.XCL_177

    c.XCL_002 = 'Germany'
    AND l.XCL_005 = '1. Bundesliga'

    AND m.XCL_010 > m.XCL_011
    AND ta.XCL_180 = 'Fast'
GROUP BY 
    t.XCL_173
ORDER BY 
    number_of_wins DESC
